<thought>The 13C NMR shows three downfield peaks: 167 ppm (carbonyl), 143.85 ppm and 130.30 ppm, which are typical for aromatic carbons. The presence of only two distinct aromatic chemical shifts suggests a symmetric aromatic ring, most likely a para‑disubstituted benzene where the six aromatic carbons give two sets of equivalent signals. Therefore the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
